description: This Java class 'ServiceMcaUtil' manages Service MCA (Mail Content Access) rules, including loading configurations, caching rules, and evaluating rules within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ServiceMcaUtil
classes.description: Utility class for managing Service MCA rules, including loading, caching, and evaluating rules.

methods.name: reloadConfig
methods.description: Clears the MCA cache and reloads configuration rules.

methods.name: readConfig
methods.description: Reads MCA configuration from component resources.

methods.name: addMcaDefinitions
methods.description: Parses and adds MCA definitions from a ResourceHandler's XML document.

methods.name: getServiceMcaRules
methods.description: Returns all cached ServiceMcaRules, loading config if cache is empty.

methods.name: evalRules
methods.description: Evaluates all MCA rules against a message, dispatcher, and user login.

calls: Debug.logImportant("Loaded " + numDefs + " Service MCA definitions from " + resourceLocation, MODULE)
